name: k2_drill_then_phantom_force
purpose: Piercing Drill (step K2, decision 0015 5dd): turn 2, Excadrill (M) with Excadrite Mega-evolves and its contact Drill Run passes Politoed's Protect (x0.25, [-ability], [-zbroken]). Ceruledge, slower than Excadrill-Mega, attacks with Phantom Force (charged on turn 1) in the same turn: Phantom Force has no protect flag and breaksProtect, so its hit lands on Politoed without the bypass (no x0.25, no [-ability], no [-zbroken]). The bypass bit of the Drill Run does not carry into Phantom Force's hit.
